description.value: Red Tomato Pies is a BC-born pizza chain founded in Williams Lake by Jason and Amber Akeson, now operating 11 locations across Western Canada including two in Kamloops. The North Shore location on Tranquille Road serves handcrafted pizzas in four sizes alongside wings, chicken dippers, salads, pasta, and desserts. The chain has grown entirely through word-of-mouth and touts an award-winning approach to fresh ingredients and creative specialty pies.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Red Tomato Pies is an active, multi-location BC pizza chain with online ordering, a full menu, and plant-based/GF options explicitly stated. The contact page lists both a 'Kamloops North Shore' and 'Kamloops Downtown' location, confirming this OSM record at 556 Tranquille Road corresponds to the North Shore location. No bike-specific amenities, washrooms, or Wi-Fi are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields are null.
concerns: The website contact page lists two Kamloops locations ('Kamloops Downtown' and 'Kamloops North Shore'). This OSM record at 556 Tranquille Road is the North Shore location; a second OSM record may exist or be needed for the Downtown location. Worth checking for duplicate OSM entries.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active pizza chain location in Kamloops with a live website and online ordering. Useful to touring cyclists seeking a substantial hot meal on the North Shore.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states: 'We carry Plant based Pepperoni, and a large selection of veggies to choose from for you to create an amazing plant based/vegan friendly pizza of your choice' and 'feel free to customize any of our Specialty Pizzas by adding plant based mozzarella instead of regular mozzarella.' Sides menu notes gluten-free 10" crust available for an additional charge on multiple items
